description: Program inputs to leaf-dag.json besides the issue export (ROUNDS-01-L03 S2, DR-0003 decisions P1 and P13): each leaf's base phase and milestone, the stage lists read from issue bodies, and the edge corrections the export's prose can't carry. Draft until re-authorization item 6 puts milestone, phase, and stages in the catalog (docs/program/reauthorization.md). A rule's match is a leaf id, a capability, or "<leaf> to <leaf>" inside one capability; the last matching rule wins. scripts/program/dag.mjs then pulls a leaf's phase and milestone earlier when a leaf that needs it lands earlier.
